name: Zoho People
summary: Zoho People is an HRIS with a free plan and four paid plans: Essential HR, Professional, Premium and Enterprise. Paid plans need at least 5 users and come with a 30-day trial. The pricing pages we could read show no dollar amounts, and they disagree on how many users the free plan allows.

facts.text: The pricing page says the Free plan includes employee database management and time-off management, and that accounts move to the Free plan when the trial ends.
The pricing page puts HR reports in Essential HR, attendance and timesheets in Professional, and performance, compensation and advanced HR analytics in Premium.
The pricing page says the Free plan is free for up to 53 users.
The pricing comparison page says Free for 5 users in one table and Free for 3 users in another.
Companies with more than 500 users are directed to request a quote.

plans.name: Free
